Definition: Tsin, a part of the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Zin is the desert in the south of Canaan, the wilderness Israel wandered in on the way to the promised land. In Numbers 13:21, searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob. The place has its own entry in Biblical Places.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the desert of Zin is where Israel learned how much they needed God, and I learn the same in dry places.
